title: IANA Considerations and IETF Protocol and Documentation Usage for IEEE 802 Parameters

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 9542 states that EtherTypes are 16-bit Ethernet protocol identifiers and that EtherTypes/LSAPs are assigned by the IEEE Registration Authority rather than IANA.
RFC 9542 describes the IANA IEEE 802 Numbers group as informational material reflecting IEEE RA assignments and specifies the IETF process for requesting new EtherTypes.

notes: Important provenance/authority record: registry presentation and assignment authority are distinct.
